Basics

What is LinkedIn comment automation?

›

LinkedIn comment automation uses AI to automatically leave relevant, contextual comments on targeted LinkedIn posts. Instead of scrolling and engaging for 1-2 hours every day, tools like PowerIn identify the right posts and generate human-sounding comments — keeping you visible to your target audience around the clock, without the time investment.

✅ Save 10+ hours per week
🛡️
Safety

Will my LinkedIn account get banned?

›

No. PowerIn was built from the ground up to stay well within LinkedIn's rate limits. It spaces comments throughout the day, mimics natural human behavior, and never exceeds safe engagement thresholds. Our algorithm adapts to your account's activity patterns and caps daily actions automatically. In 2+ years with over 6,000 users, zero accounts have been banned.

✅ Zero bans in 2+ years of operation
🎯
Targeting

How does PowerIn find the right posts to comment on?

›

Two powerful options: Creator Targeting lets you pick specific LinkedIn creators — industry leaders, competitors, thought leaders — and automatically comment on their posts. Keyword Targeting scans LinkedIn in real time for posts containing your chosen terms (like "B2B SaaS", "recruiting", "AI startups"). Both modes ensure every comment lands in a relevant conversation in front of qualified eyes.

✅ Two targeting modes for maximum precision
🤖
AI Quality

Can people tell the comments are AI-generated?

›

No. PowerIn's AI reads the full context of each post before generating a response. Every comment is unique, on-topic, and matches the tone and language of the original post. You set your preferred voice — professional, casual, witty, or expert — and the AI adapts to sound like you. The result: comments that are indistinguishable from something you'd write yourself.

✅ Context-aware, human-sounding comments
📊
Volume

How many comments does PowerIn post per day?

›

It depends on your settings and the volume of matching posts. PowerIn manages rate limiting automatically — you never have to worry about exceeding safe thresholds. Most users see 15-40 comments placed per day across their targeted creators and keywords. That's 15-40 times your name, face, and headline appear in front of a new audience — every single day.

✅ 15-40 targeted comments daily
⚡
Speed

How fast does PowerIn comment after a post goes live?

›

PowerIn monitors your targets in real time. Comments are typically placed within 30 minutes of a post going live — putting you among the very first commenters, when visibility and engagement are at their absolute peak. Early comments get the most likes, the most replies, and the most profile clicks. PowerIn makes sure you're always early.

✅ Comments within 30 minutes of publishing
📈
Results

How does commenting on posts actually lead to clients?

›

Every comment puts your name, photo, and headline in front of a new audience. This creates "passive familiarity" — people start recognizing you before you ever reach out. When you eventually connect or message them, they already feel like they know you. The result: PowerIn users report 3-5x higher response rates compared to cold outreach, and many land their first inbound leads within 30 days.

✅ 3-5x higher response rates vs cold outreach
⚔️
Comparison

How is PowerIn different from other LinkedIn automation tools?

›

Most LinkedIn automation tools focus on connection requests and direct messages — which are heavily monitored and frequently trigger restrictions. PowerIn focuses on comments — the safest and most underrated growth lever on LinkedIn. Comments don't trip spam filters the way mass connection requests or InMails do, and they generate organic visibility that compounds over time.

✅ Comments = safest LinkedIn growth lever
🌍
Languages

Does PowerIn work in languages other than English?

›

Yes — all languages are supported automatically. PowerIn detects the language of each post and generates a comment in the same language. French post? French comment. German post? German comment. You can also filter by timezone to comment during local business hours for your prospects. Ideal for international sales teams and multilingual professionals.

✅ Auto-detects and matches any language
⚠️
Reputation

Will it comment on political or controversial posts?

›

Never. PowerIn includes built-in sensitive content protection. It automatically scans every post before commenting and skips anything related to politics, discrimination, tragedies, or other controversial topics. Your professional reputation stays clean — PowerIn will never associate your name with the wrong conversation.

✅ Sensitive content filter always active
⏱️
Setup

How long does it take to set up?

›

5 minutes. Connect your LinkedIn account, pick the creators or keywords you want to target, choose your preferred tone of voice — and you're live. No complicated onboarding, no learning curve. PowerIn starts commenting for you automatically and you can expect your first results within 24-48 hours.

✅ Live in under 5 minutes
📈
Analytics

How do I track what PowerIn is doing?

›

Two ways. A real-time dashboard shows every comment placed, impressions generated, and your growth metrics (connections, followers, profile views). Plus, you get a daily email report every morning summarizing yesterday's performance across LinkedIn and X (Twitter) — comments placed, views earned, likes and replies received. Full transparency, zero guesswork.

✅ Dashboard + daily email reports
⚙️
Customization

Can I review comments before they go live?

›

Yes. PowerIn offers a manual approval mode where you can review and approve every comment before it's posted. You can also define words to avoid, add or remove emojis, and set your preferred voice tone. Most users start with manual approval for the first few days, then switch to fully automatic once they trust the quality. You're always in control.

✅ Manual approval mode available
𝕏
Platforms

Does PowerIn also work on X (Twitter)?

›

Yes. PowerIn supports both LinkedIn and X (Twitter). The same targeting logic applies — pick creators or keywords, and PowerIn comments automatically on matching posts across both platforms. Your daily email report and dashboard cover both LinkedIn and X activity, so you can track everything from one place.

✅ LinkedIn + X (Twitter) supported
💳
Pricing

Is there a free trial? Can I cancel anytime?

›

Yes and yes. PowerIn offers a free 5-day trial — no credit card required. After that, you can cancel anytime with one click, no questions asked. There's zero commitment and zero risk. We're confident you'll see results within the trial period, but if it's not for you, you won't pay a thing.

✅ Free 5-day trial, cancel in 1 click
💬
Support

What if I need help or have a question?

›

Our team is available 7 days a week via live chat, email, or WhatsApp — average response time under 2 hours. Whether you need help with setup, want to optimize your targeting strategy, or just have a question — we're here. PowerIn isn't just a tool, it's a team that wants to see you succeed.

✅ Support 7 days a week, under 2h response
💬
Still have questions?

Our team is here to help! Reach out anytime via the chat widget in the bottom right corner.
